# Markdown sticker

A small **read-only** note on the desktop. 한국어도 그대로 표시합니다.

- Open an existing `.md` file.
- Pin above other windows.
- Scroll without editing the source.

> Keep it simple: a viewer, not a notebook manager.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+O | Open Markdown |
| F5 | Reload |

```text
Original Markdown stays unchanged.
```

[Project](https://github.com/mud-the-developer/rusty-note)

## End

Surrounding content should still fit at a narrow width.
